verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent operates as a team member inside major ticketing/chat platforms (Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, Pylon), and its Pylon integration explicitly covers email, live chat, and Slack tickets, showing some multi-channel reach. However, there is no evidence of native WhatsApp or social-media channel support, so the 'channels customers actually use' claim is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit WhatsApp support, explicit social media channel support, and independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
